affix.name: Silken Moon's Serenade
affix.desc: When dealing Elemental DMG, gain the Gleaming Moon: Devotion effect for 8s: Increases all party members' Elemental Mastery by 60/120 when the party's Moonsign is Nascent Gleam/Ascendant Gleam. The equipping character can trigger this effect while off-field. All party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is increased by 10% for each different Gleaming Moon effect that party members have. Effects from Gleaming Moon cannot stack.

equip_ring.name: Joyous Glory of the Pure
equip_ring.desc: An immaculate silver cup said to have been used in the bygone rituals of the Frostmoon Scions. Their modern rites have no need for such a vessel.

equip_necklace.name: Pristine Plume of the Blessed
equip_necklace.desc: An immaculate feathered accessory said to have been forged by the first Moonchanter herself.

equip_dress.name: Holy Crown of the Believer
equip_dress.desc: An immaculate adornment created in imitation of the envoy of the grove's antlers.

equip_bracer.name: Crystal Tear of the Wanderer
equip_bracer.desc: An immaculate flower whose beauty is said to have been preserved for eternity by the icy wind.

equip_shoes.name: Frost Devotee's Delirium
equip_shoes.desc: An immaculate timepiece that long ago ceased turning, along with the delusions of its former owner.
